g.text: Arlanda Rising: the map (data/layout.js), north up
metres from the 01L threshold; grid 100 m; every era at once
orange: buildings · grey: aprons · brown: roads · purple: railway (dashed: tunnel)
blue dashes: the biggest aircraft each stand takes (dot: the stop bar)
pink: the satellite design of the player's pier (instead of the finger)
green dashes: the airside fence with everything built (render/fence.js)
